thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> P1: az2-serving-degrade (zone: az2, region: eu-west). page_id=PD-98321

pagerduty-bot: Alert summary: high 5xx rate from az2, slot eviction spikes, increased tail latency. automated repeats: 3 times in 2m.

robin_oncall: acked. I'm up. Looking now. What impact are we seeing? :eyes:

aj: grabbing metrics + logs. can anyone confirm if this is NIC flap or scheduler eviction?

ops-bot: quick telemetry: az2 egress errors + host-level kvcache evictions. sample log: 
```
2026-03-15T14:02:07Z host-az2-47 kernel: mlx5_core 0000:81:00.1: PF VF down
2026-03-15T14:02:09Z model-serving: cache_eviction: model=llama-13b shard=3 evict_count=124
```

robin_oncall: thanks. aj, can you run redwoodctl status for az2 pods?

aj: running: `redwoodctl status --region eu-west --az az2 --json` -> show below (truncated):
```
{ "az": "az2", "healthy_nodes": 42, "degraded": 8, "pending_evictions": 120, "queue_depth": 1.9 }
```

aj: network errors correlate with pod restarts on hosts 47/49/51. Looks like NIC flaps causing kernel rebinds.

sylvie: are we seeing customer errors? SLO alerting for customers with reserved capacity in eu-west shows ~12 customers >5xx rate. Customer-facing pages trending up.

robin_oncall: initiating failover plan: route policy -> divert 30% steady traffic from az2 -> az1 in eu-west, and increase us-east capacity if needed. Can someone update routing?

eng-lead-mike: I'm on routing update. toggling diversion: `rw-router update --route model-gen --policy divert --from az2 --to az1 --percent 30`

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: az2-serving-degrade not acknowledged by primary within 5m -> notified eng-lead-mike.

ops-bot: small note: we have an alert-suppressor firing due to repeated PD noise. policy: suppress if identical alerts >5 in 2m to prevent PD storm. I'm temporarily disabling suppressor for this thread so ops team receives each signal.

robin_oncall: good call. we need visibility, don't suppress. sylvie, please draft customer impact note for status page. include that we diverted traffic and are investigating root.

sylvie: drafting now. status: degraded performance in eu-west/az2 affecting text generation and chat sessions for some customers. mitigation: traffic divert to eu-west/az1 and us-east initiated. ETA for full restoration: unknown. will update in 15m.

aj: applied kernel NIC rebind workaround on host-47/49. rolling host reboot scheduled for 5 hosts in az2. command run: `ssh host-47 sudo systemctl restart mlx5-mod` -> kernel logs show link recover but kvcache still has high miss.

robin_oncall: can we cold-fail any overloaded hosts out of the pool to stop noisy evictions?

eng-lead-mike: yes triggering graceful drain on hosts 47/49/51: `redwoodctl drain-host host-47 --grace 30s`

pagerduty-bot: PD note: manual acknowledgment from robin_oncall. escalation paused.

robin_oncall: assigning SRE handoff to aj for 30m. aj -> keep me posted, escalate to hardware team if NIC continues flapping.

aj: ok taking handoff. creating PD incident note: investigation+mitigation steps + runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az-network-degrade

ops-bot: quick check: autoscaler in az1 scaled +20% to absorb diverted traffic. throughput target met, latency improved for diverted requests.

sylvie: posted status update (internal): "Investigating network flaps in eu-west/az2. Traffic diversion in progress. Some customers may see degraded performance. Will update." :loud_sound:

eng-lead-mike: request to Infra: open ticket to hardware vendor for NIC hardware replacement on affected hosts. tagging: @infra-team.

infra-team (via ops-bot): ticket created INC-2026-az2-NIC. vendor engaged. ETA on physical swap: 48h unless remote repair possible.

robin_oncall: plan for medium-term: keep diversion at 30% for now, continue draining noisy hosts, monitor evictions. if persistent after 1h, plan full-circuit failover of az2 traffic to az1 and us-east.

pagerduty-bot: Alert suppression re-enabled (manual) to avoid PD fatigue after we restored visibility and suppressed duplicates.

aj: follow-up telemetry: eviction rate down 60% after drains. queue_depth back to 0.4. still seeing isolated 5xx spikes tied to hosts being drained.

sylvie: customer impact list compiled: 12 customers with >1% error increase, 3 customers with reserved workloads impacted (account IDs redacted in channel). CSMs pinged.

robin_oncall: thanks team. leaving this thread open. next update 15:50Z or on status change. if anyone sees regression, ping here and PD will re-open. :white_check_mark:

eng-lead-mike: adding post-incident actions: 1) investigate suppressor thresholds, 2) add better host-level NIC health probes, 3) improve runbook to include immediate drain step, 4) update routing safety checks.

ops-bot: logging timeline to incident tracker INC-98321.

robin_oncall: closing PD incident for paging (ack resolved) — incident remains active for mitigation and RCA. final update when hardware swap scheduled. :memo:

sylvie: final internal note posted + scheduled customer update in 1h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

robin_oncall: last check: `redwoodctl status --az az2` -> healthy_nodes: 39, degraded: 3, pending_evictions: 12. Moving to monitoring state.

incident-bot: Thread archived to incidents/INC-98321 after handoff.
